import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0027 (a b c : Nat) (h1 : a ≤ b + c) (h2 : b ≤ a + c) : a ≤ b := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0027 (a b c : Nat) (h1 : a ≤ b + c) (h2 : b ≤ a + c) : a ≤ b := by
  have h3 : a + b ≤ b + c + a + c by
    rw [add_assoc, add_comm c a, add_assoc, add_comm b c]
    exact h1.trans (h2.trans (add_le_add_right h2))
  have h4 : a + b ≤ a + b by
    rw [add_comm a b] at h3
    exact le_of_add_le_add_right h3
  exact le_of_add_le_add_left h4
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0027 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0027 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0027

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0027
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0027
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
